self.text: I’m Petra, a Vietnamese guy in my early 20s who loves running trails in the quiet mornings, but the real thrill comes when I hop onto my console to dive into Skyforge Arena. I mostly queue for casual games, keeping the vibe relaxed and fun. When we’re in a match, I stick to text chat, sending quick updates and coordinating moves without the noise of voice. My role is flexible – I’m happy to fill any spot the team needs, whether that’s support, DPS, or tank. I’m free on Saturday mornings and either Sunday morning or afternoon, so we can jump in whenever the squad’s ready. It’s all about teamwork, good pacing, and enjoying the game together.
